subject: [PATCH v3 1/2] x86/lib: Keep the scalar memcpy() count in RCX

2026-11-11.patch_summary: This patch modifies the x86 implementation of the memcpy function to store the loop count in the RCX register instead of RDX, and uses RDX as a temporary for small-copy data. This change is made to prepare for the ERMS size check to use RDX as scratch while preserving the REP MOVSB count in RCX. The patch does not introduce any functional changes.
